entry.en: Cambodia requires a passport valid for at least 6 months from the arrival date and undamaged, with no missing pages.
entry.es: Camboya exige un pasaporte válido al menos 6 meses desde la fecha de llegada, sin daños y sin páginas faltantes.
entry.quote:
valid for at least 6 months from the date you arrive in Cambodia

- undamaged and complete – entry is normally refused if you have a damaged passport or pages missing

entry.en: Air arrivals at Phnom Penh, Siem Reap or Sihanoukville must submit a free electronic e-Arrival Card within 7 days before arrival.
entry.es: Quien llega por aire a Phnom Penh, Siem Reap o Sihanoukville debe enviar la tarjeta electrónica e-Arrival, gratuita, en los 7 días previos a la llegada.
entry.quote: you must complete and submit an electronic e-Arrival Card within 7 days prior to your arrival. There is no charge for this.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si se llega desde un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Overstaying a visa can lead to a fine with no limit, detention and deportation.
entry.es: Exceder la estancia del visado puede acarrear una multa sin límite, detención y deportación.
entry.quote: You can be fined, detained and deported if you overstay your visa. There is no limit to this fine.

entry.en: Hotels and guesthouses must register guests through the FPCS app, and those staying privately must register themselves.
entry.es: Los hoteles y alojamientos deben registrar a los huéspedes en la app FPCS, y quien se aloja en una casa particular debe registrarse por su cuenta.
entry.quote: If you’re staying in a hotel, guesthouse or rented accommodation, make sure the manager or landlord registers you using the app.

safety.en: Most theft is bag snatching, often by thieves on motorbikes who cut straps and grab bags or phones from people on foot, in tuk-tuks or on motorbikes.
safety.es: La mayoría de los robos son tirones de bolsos, a menudo por ladrones en moto que cortan correas y arrebatan bolsos o teléfonos a peatones o a quienes van en tuk-tuk o moto.
safety.quote: Most incidents of theft are bag snatchings, often by thieves riding past on motorbikes. Thieves will cut bag straps and snatch bags or phones from tourists on foot or in tuk-tuks and on motorbikes

safety.en: Cambodia remains heavily affected by landmines and unexploded weapons, and mined areas are often unmarked.
safety.es: Camboya sigue muy afectada por minas terrestres y artefactos sin explotar, y las zonas minadas a menudo no están señalizadas.
safety.quote: Cambodia remains heavily affected by landmines and unexploded weapons. Mined areas are often unmarked.

safety.en: Protests, demonstrations and rallies should be avoided because they can become violent without warning.
safety.es: Se deben evitar protestas, manifestaciones y mítines porque pueden volverse violentos sin aviso.
safety.quote: Avoid all protests, demonstrations and student and political rallies as they can become violent without warning.

safety.en: Alcoholic drinks containing methanol have caused deaths and serious illness in Cambodia, and methanol cannot be identified by taste or smell.
safety.es: Bebidas alcohólicas con metanol han causado muertes y enfermedades graves en Camboya, y el metanol no se puede identificar por el sabor ni el olor.
safety.quote:
There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Cambodia.

Even small amounts of methanol can kill. It is not possible to identify methanol in alcoholic drinks by taste or smell.

safety.en: Cambodia has one of the highest rates of road traffic accidents in south-east Asia, and travel after dark significantly increases the risk of accidents.
safety.es: Camboya tiene una de las mayores tasas de accidentes de tráfico del sudeste asiático, y viajar de noche aumenta significativamente el riesgo de accidentes.
safety.quote: Cambodia has one of the highest rates of road traffic accidents in south-east Asia. There are large numbers of fatalities and serious injuries. Many accidents are due to poor vehicle and driver safety standards. Travel after dark significantly increases the risk of accidents.

safety.en: Possession of any illegal drugs, including cannabis, is a serious offence in Cambodia.
safety.es: La posesión de cualquier droga ilegal, incluido el cannabis, es un delito grave en Camboya.
safety.quote: Possession, trafficking and manufacture of any illegal drugs are serious offences in Cambodia. This includes cannabis.

health.en: Tap water is generally not drinkable in Cambodia.
health.es: El agua del grifo en general no es potable en Camboya.
health.quote: Tap water is generally not drinkable, so avoid it.

health.en: Phnom Penh is malaria-free, Siem Reap and Angkor Wat are virtually malaria-free, and malaria prophylaxis is recommended for most other places.
health.es: Phnom Penh no tiene malaria, Siem Reap y Angkor Wat casi no la tienen, y se recomienda profilaxis en la mayoría de los demás lugares.
health.quote: Phnom Penh is malaria-free, and Siem Reap and Angkor Wat are virtually malaria-free. Malaria prophylaxis is recommended for most other places in the country.

health.en: Mosquito-borne dengue fever is described as the biggest disease worry.
health.es: El dengue transmitido por mosquitos se describe como la mayor preocupación sanitaria.
health.quote: The biggest disease worry is mosquito-borne dengue fever

health.en: Cambodia lacks reliable medical facilities, especially in rural areas.
health.es: Camboya carece de instalaciones médicas fiables, sobre todo en zonas rurales.
health.quote: Cambodia lacks reliable medical facilities, doctors, clinics, hospitals and medication, especially in rural areas.

health.en: Travellers should check they have travel insurance that covers local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: Conviene comprobar que se tiene un seguro de viaje que cubra tratamiento local o evacuación médica imprevista.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

help.en: The emergency numbers are police 117, fire 118 and ambulance 119.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son policía 117, bomberos 118 y ambulancia 119.

help.en: Crimes can be reported to the tourist police, who can provide a police report for insurance purposes.
help.es: Los delitos pueden denunciarse a la policía turística, que puede dar un informe policial para el seguro.
help.quote:
If you want to report a crime, you can go to the tourist police.  

You can get a police report for insurance purposes

getting_in.en: Visa on arrival is available at both international airports and all six international border crossings with Thailand.
getting_in.es: El visado a la llegada está disponible en ambos aeropuertos internacionales y en los seis cruces fronterizos internacionales con Tailandia.
getting_in.quote: VOA is available at both international airports, all six international border crossings with Thailand

getting_in.en: Staff at some border crossings, including airports, may try to charge more than the official visa price.
getting_in.es: El personal de algunos cruces fronterizos, incluidos aeropuertos, puede intentar cobrar más que el precio oficial del visado.
getting_in.quote: Staff may try to charge more at some border crossings (including airports), but hold out for the official price

getting_in.en: An e-Visa is said to protect against border scams such as agents demanding a small bribe to process a visa on arrival.
getting_in.es: Se dice que la e-Visa protege de estafas en la frontera, como agentes que piden un pequeño soborno por tramitar el visado a la llegada.
getting_in.quote: Having an e-Visa protects you from various scams at the border, e.g. border agents demanding a small bribe for processing your VOA.

getting_around.en: Three airports have scheduled passenger flights: Phnom Penh, Siem Reap and Sihanoukville.
getting_around.es: Tres aeropuertos tienen vuelos regulares de pasajeros: Phnom Penh, Siem Reap y Sihanoukville.
getting_around.quote: Three airports operate scheduled passenger flights: Phnom Penh, Siem Reap, and Sihanoukville.

getting_around.en: Giant Ibis and Mekong Express have the best reputation for comfort, safety and reliability among bus companies and charge a premium.
getting_around.es: Giant Ibis y Mekong Express tienen la mejor reputación en comodidad, seguridad y fiabilidad entre las compañías de autobús y cobran más.
getting_around.quote: Giant Ibis and Mekong Express have the best reputation for comfort, safety, and reliability and consequently charge a premium.

getting_around.en: Bus safety is a big problem, with dozens of bus crashes each year on Highway 5 between Phnom Penh and Battambang.
getting_around.es: La seguridad de los autobuses es un gran problema, con decenas de accidentes al año en la carretera 5 entre Phnom Penh y Battambang.
getting_around.quote: Bus safety is a big problem in Cambodia. On Hwy 5, between Phnom Penh and Battambang, there are dozens of bus crashes annually

getting_around.en: Travellers should agree on a fare and make sure the tuk-tuk driver knows the destination before getting in.
getting_around.es: Hay que acordar la tarifa y asegurarse de que el conductor de tuk-tuk conozca el destino antes de subir.
getting_around.quote: Agree on a fare and make sure the driver knows your destination before you get in the vehicle.

getting_around.en: The main ride-hailing apps are Grab and PassApp, and PassApp requires paying the driver in cash while Grab allows card payment.
getting_around.es: Las principales apps de transporte son Grab y PassApp; PassApp exige pagar al conductor en efectivo y Grab permite pagar con tarjeta de crédito.
getting_around.quote: The main ride-hailing apps in Cambodia are Grab and PassApp. Of the two, PassApp is available in more cities and is usually slightly cheaper, but requires you to pay the driver in cash, while Grab gives you the option of paying the driver by credit card.

money.en: The riel and the US dollar are both official currencies, and the riel is used for regular transactions.
money.es: El riel y el dólar estadounidense son monedas oficiales, y el riel se usa en las transacciones habituales.
money.quote: The Cambodian riel, denoted by the symbol "៛" (ISO code: KHR), and the United States dollar (USD) are both official currencies.

money.en: The text says 4,000 riel per dollar is ubiquitous in day-to-day commerce.
money.es: El texto indica que en el comercio diario es habitual usar 4.000 riel por dólar.
money.quote: In day-to-day commerce, 4,000 riel per dollar is ubiquitous.

money.en: ATMs are available in most places, though they might not always be the bank you are looking for.
money.es: Hay cajeros automáticos en la mayoría de los lugares, aunque no siempre del banco que se busca.
money.quote: ATMs are available in most places, but they might not always be the bank you are looking for.

money.en: Visa, MasterCard and JCB are the most widely accepted cards.
money.es: Visa, MasterCard y JCB son las tarjetas más aceptadas.
money.quote: Visa, MasterCard, and JCB are most widely accepted

money.en: Torn or old series foreign currency notes may be difficult to exchange or simply not be accepted.
money.es: Los billetes extranjeros rotos o antiguos pueden ser difíciles de cambiar o no ser aceptados.
money.quote: Torn or old series foreign currency notes may be difficult to exchange or simply not be accepted

etiquette.en: Visitors should ask permission before taking a photo of someone, as many in remote areas dislike being photographed.
etiquette.es: Se debe pedir permiso antes de fotografiar a alguien, ya que a muchos en zonas remotas no les gusta ser fotografiados.
etiquette.quote: Always ask permission before you take somebody's picture, as many in the more remote areas do not like to be photographed

etiquette.en: Dress for women is quite conservative, and knee-length shorts or trousers are more respectful outside Phnom Penh and Siem Reap.
etiquette.es: La vestimenta femenina es bastante conservadora, y fuera de Phnom Penh y Siem Reap es más respetuoso llevar shorts hasta la rodilla o pantalones.
etiquette.quote: Dress for women is quite conservative in Cambodia. While shorts are now acceptable in Phnom Penh and Siem Reap, it is more respectful to wear knee length shorts or trousers when outside of these areas.

etiquette.en: Business cards should be given and received with the right hand, as using the left hand is considered a major faux pas.
etiquette.es: Las tarjetas de visita se dan y reciben con la mano derecha, pues usar la izquierda se considera una grave falta de etiqueta.
etiquette.quote: When giving or receiving business cards, be sure to use your right hand with the palm facing up

etiquette.en: Monks must avoid physical contact with women, so women offering food should place it on a cloth in front of the monk.
etiquette.es: Los monjes deben evitar el contacto físico con mujeres, por lo que ellas deben dejar la comida sobre una tela frente al monje.
etiquette.quote: Monks must avoid physical contact with females, so women who wish to offer food to a monk should place it on a piece of cloth in front of him so he can pick it up.

etiquette.en: Skirts or shorts above the knee may lead to refusal of entry to religious sites such as Angkor Wat, and bare shoulders should be covered.
etiquette.es: Las faldas o shorts por encima de la rodilla pueden causar que se niegue la entrada a sitios religiosos como Angkor Wat, y hay que cubrir los hombros.
etiquette.quote: You may be refused admission to religious sites, including Angkor Wat, if you wear skirts or shorts above the knee. Cover bare shoulders.

connectivity.en: Cambodia uses GSM, with cellcard the largest operator followed by Smart and Metfone.
connectivity.es: Camboya usa GSM, con cellcard como mayor operador, seguido de Smart y Metfone.
connectivity.quote: Cambodia uses the GSM mobile system and cellcard is the largest operator, then Smart then Metfone.

connectivity.en: A passport must be shown at a carrier store to get a SIM card.
connectivity.es: Hay que mostrar el pasaporte en una tienda del operador para obtener una SIM.
connectivity.quote: You are required to show your passport at a carrier store to get a SIM.

connectivity.en: Wi-Fi and mobile networks are good in the main cities and towns, but many islands and remote areas are not well covered.
connectivity.es: El wifi y las redes móviles son buenos en las principales ciudades, pero muchas islas y zonas remotas tienen poca cobertura.
connectivity.quote: While there is good wi-fi and mobile phone networks in the main cities and towns of Cambodia, many of the islands and remote areas are not well covered.

phrases.quote: If you are male the word for 'yes' is pronounced 'baht' (បាទ) as in the sound of a sheep followed by a hard T.
If you are female the word for 'yes' is pronounced 'jah' (ចា) as in the first part of 'jar'.
The word for 'no' is pronounced 'otDay' (អត់ទេ/ទេ)
